lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Zn2Pt6 (reduced formula SrZnPt3) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Pt centers with 9 geometric neighbors (6 Pt, 1 Sr, 2 Zn) and Sr centers with 12 Pt neighbors, while Zn centers have 9 Pt neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Pt-centered 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Pt- and Sr-centered polyhedra.
